name: hybrid_directory_execution
scope_warning: Small, single-host executions including preprocessing: one residual-dependent query for controlled A/B and the ten distinct fixture queries after optimization. This is not evidence of real-dataset scalability or sublinear access.
status: executed small-fixture validation and ten-query regression
threat_model: MP-SPDZ Semi; passive dishonest majority; any two of three servers may collude
fixture: ten_query owners, one alice/referred_to/treated_with query; hop two's bob and eve keys reside in the hashed residual

layout.coverage: all edges; primary-type keys in affine blocks and multi-domain exceptions in hashed residual

batched_residual_tag_optimization.change: batch Fibonacci-hash decomposition across addresses and decompose each wanted tag once before broadcasting its secret bits across bucket slots
batched_residual_tag_optimization.interpretation: Communication and preprocessing decrease, while this single localhost timing is unchanged within run noise and rounds rise slightly. This is not evidence of a latency speedup.

optimized_ten_query_execution.phase: program version 4, scalar candidate/top-k per query
optimized_ten_query_execution.compiler_line_observation: approximately 4.2 million lines; batching removed the previous hard failure but compiler expansion remains material

simd_candidate_topk_ten_query_execution.phase: program version 5, candidate-major QUERY_COUNT-lane SIMD candidate formation and top-k
simd_candidate_topk_ten_query_execution.compiler_observation: Compilation completed, but compiler progress still exceeded 4.1 million expanded lines and dependency scheduling processed 1,044,141 vector instructions. SIMD reduced online rounds and localhost runtime, not the dominant cryptographic work or communication.
simd_candidate_topk_ten_query_execution.timer_semantics: Timers 20 and 21 cover the whole batch in program version 5. Program version 4 used timer pairs 20..39 per query, so individual candidate timer values are not directly comparable; compare end-to-end values and compiler resource counts.

relation_folded_hybrid_primary.change: select relation_2's public type block once per query, pad it in secret registers to the public maximum type-block width, and resolve every secret frontier entity by relative offset; always execute the unchanged hashed-residual lookup in parallel
relation_folded_hybrid_primary.security: relation, selected type block, relative entity offsets, primary descriptors, and residual hits remain secret; loop bounds and trace depend only on the public ontology layout and batch configuration

folded_plus_simd_ten_query.compiler_observation: Compilation completed but still reached approximately 4.0 million expanded lines and dependency scheduling still processed 1,044,141 vector instructions. Folding reduced thread tapes and online MPC rounds, not the dominant residual/page compiler graph.

relation_folded_hybrid_primary.scope: Executed only on the ten-query synthetic hybrid fixture. The relative benefit grows with primary type-block rows and frontier width, but no MetaQA or WebQSP MPC result is established.

batched_descriptor_page_unpacking.change: gather all descriptors requested from one owner, bit-decompose the descriptor vector once, fetch the fixed page windows, and bit-decompose the complete edge window once; field reconstruction remains lane-wise and the scalar unpacking implementation remains available only as the relation-check ablation
batched_descriptor_page_unpacking.security: batching changes the public instruction schedule only; owner count, batch size, page bounds, and window sizes were already public, and no descriptor, page count, edge, address, relation, or validity bit is opened

one_query.compiler_line_observation: approximately 200,000 expanded lines versus approximately 400,000 for program version 6

ten_query.compiler_observation: compiler progress reached approximately 700,000 expanded lines versus approximately 4.0 million for program version 6; these are progress observations rather than exact source-line counts

multi_page_validation.purpose: exercise page/address/slot flattening with an actual overflow page; this is a correctness validation, not a performance result

batched_descriptor_page_unpacking.scope: The optimization materially reduces generated-program and bytecode size on the ten-query small fixture, but does not reduce the cryptographic product counts, the linear directory scans, or measured online cost. It is not evidence of MetaQA or WebQSP MPC scalability.

owner_batched_page_resolution.change: decompose the packed descriptor matrix once even when multiple owners share a field element, resolve owner page bases in owner-major lanes, evaluate fixed page windows in public owner batches capped by the compiler-width threshold, and unpack the complete owner/address edge window once
owner_batched_page_resolution.security: owner batching changes only the public instruction schedule; all owners, page budgets, batch widths, addresses, descriptors, page counts, edges, and validity values have the same visibility as version 7 and no additional value is opened

ten_query.compiler_observation: compiler progress reached approximately 500,000 expanded lines, but aggregate bytecode increased because the emitted instructions carry substantially wider vectors

multi_page_validation.purpose: validate owner/address/page/slot flattening with a real second page

owner_batched_page_resolution.scope: This is a measured online optimization on small synthetic fixtures. It does not change the linear directory/page scans, establish WAN behavior, or establish real-dataset MPC scalability.

relation_partitioned_hybrid_residual.change: store hybrid residual keys in uniformly padded relation-major compact tables, tag slots by entity only, and form the secret table row from the secret relation and secret entity-derived bucket inside MPC
relation_partitioned_hybrid_residual.security: the relation partition is selected by a secret demultiplexer over every padded residual row; relation, entity, bucket, match, and descriptor remain secret, and preparation fails closed on a per-owner per-relation bucket overflow
relation_partitioned_hybrid_residual.validation_history: The first v9 native run was rejected after matching only 111/160 fields: its one-bucket circuit incorrectly extracted one hash bit while storage used constant bucket zero. Version 10 makes the one-bucket address explicitly zero and matches 160/160 fields on the same prepared shares.
relation_partitioned_hybrid_residual.scope: The measured win is fixture-specific because relation partitioning permits smaller safe public bucket and slot bounds here. If relation_count times the padded per-relation table exceeds the combined-key table, this layout can lose. It remains a linear secret-index scan, not sublinear DORAM.

claim_boundary: This establishes executable full-coverage hybrid semantics, including dependent hashed-residual access, on ten distinct small-fixture queries. It does not establish MetaQA/WebQSP scalability, sublinear access, or a new cryptographic primitive.
